github.requires: Explicit repository identity, read-only scopes, provider authentication

gitnexus.requires: Pinned installed CLI and the consumer's local index

chrome-devtools.requires: Pinned CLI and isolated browser context

playwright.requires: Pinned CLI and isolated browser context

shadcn.requires: Actual frontend registry and pinned declared package tooling

postman.requires: Maintained collection and approved private workspace credentials

azure.requires: Read-only tool selection and approved subscription identity

terraform.requires: Applicable non-Azure targets; registry toolset only by default

azure-devops.requires: Consumer-specific organization, project, and least-privilege identity
